announcements.all.description: Link from the announcements above the home timeline and in the side column to the list page of every announcement, the ended ones included.

announcements.empty.defaultMessage: まだお知らせはありません
announcements.empty.description: Heading of the empty list page of the announcements.

announcements.empty.description.defaultMessage: このサーバーの運営からのお知らせがここに並びます。
announcements.empty.description.description: Text of the empty list page of the announcements.

announcements.ended.description: Marker of an announcement that no longer shows, next to its heading on the list page.

announcements.ended_at.description: When an ended announcement stopped showing, on the list page. {date} is the date and time, formatted.

announcements.heading.description: Heading of an announcement that has no title. {date} is the day it started to show, formatted.

announcements.list.failed.defaultMessage: お知らせを読み込めませんでした
announcements.list.failed.description: Error in place of the list of announcements when it could not be loaded.

announcements.loading.defaultMessage: お知らせを読み込んでいます
announcements.loading.description: Text for screen readers while the list page of the announcements loads.

announcements.mark_read.description: Button that marks an announcement read.

announcements.mark_read_failed.defaultMessage: お知らせを既読にできませんでした: {reason}
announcements.mark_read_failed.description: Error after marking an announcement read failed. {reason} is why.

announcements.more.description: Button at the end of the list of announcements that loads older ones.

announcements.more_failed.defaultMessage: 続きのお知らせを読み込めませんでした
announcements.more_failed.description: Error at the end of the list of announcements when older ones could not be loaded.

announcements.retry.description: Button that loads the list of announcements again after it failed.

announcements.title.description: Heading of the server's announcements: the list page, its item of the navigation, the region above the home timeline, and the panel of the side column.

announcements.unread.description: Marker of an announcement that the user has not read, next to its heading.

announcements.unread_count.description: The number of unread announcements on the badge next to the heading of the announcements, for example '2 unread'.

announcements.until.description: When an announcement stops showing. {date} is the date and time, formatted.

announcements.withdrawn.defaultMessage: このお知らせは取り下げられたため、表示されません。
announcements.withdrawn.description: Note above the list of announcements when the page was opened for one (from a notification) that the administrators withdrew.
